input.overview: Crew jobs, Side Jobs, jail rescues, Crane Multiball, and Police Multiball feed the larger Heists. Start a crew job before adding a prepared Multiball, collect its MacGuffin, and recover jailed specialists so the Mastermind and Big Final Heist remain available.
input.simpleOverview: Hit a crew member's major shot twice to start that job. Prepare Crane or Police Multiball first, start the crew job, then add the Multiball; failed specialists can be recovered at the center jail.
input.summary: Choose a safe crew shot and hit it twice to start the job. Add a prepared Crane or Police Multiball, finish the task, and collect its MacGuffin at the raised scoop. Rescue jailed specialists and complete the Mastermind before entering the Big Final Heist.

quickInfo.name: Crew jobs
quickInfo.summary: Wheelman is the left orbit, Cat Burglar the left ramp, Safecracker the right horseshoe, Hacker the right ramp, and Demolition the right orbit; hit one twice to start.

quickInfo.name: Jailbreak
quickInfo.summary: Hit the center jail to open it, then shoot the scoop to start one extra ball for every specialist currently jailed.

quickInfo.name: Police Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Hit the blue police targets to light the two horseshoe locks, collect three locks, then shoot the lit jackpot pairs and jail advances.

quickInfo.name: Crane Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Build enough cash at the ATM and armored car, shoot the right ramp, then knock the held ball from the crane to begin scoring.

quickInfo.name: Mastermind
quickInfo.summary: After two recruits, qualify the Mastermind at the left horseshoe; more recruited crew produce a larger and harder jewel heist.

steps.text: Choose the crew shot with the safest return and hit it twice to start its job: left orbit, left ramp, right horseshoe, right ramp, or right orbit.
Before the second crew hit, prepare Crane Multiball through cash and the right ramp, or prepare Police Multiball through the blue targets and horseshoe locks.
Start the crew job first, then collect the prepared Multiball. Use the extra balls to finish the timed task without abandoning its required shots.
When the crew task is complete, shoot the raised scoop for its MacGuffin. A full completion recruits the specialist; a failure sends that specialist to jail.
For a rescue, hit the center jail to open it and shoot the scoop. Jailbreak serves the ball in play plus one ball for each jailed specialist.
After at least two recruits, use the left horseshoe for the Mastermind. Recruit more crew first when the larger jewel route remains practical.

fallback.title: Side Job route
fallback.when: Use this when a direct crew-start shot is rejecting but the side targets and crane are safer.

steps.text: Complete the side targets, hit the crane when it moves into reach, then shoot the opened OCPD building to start the Side Job.
Complete the short Side Job to qualify its linked crew member without the first direct crew hit.
Return to that crew shot to start the job, then add a prepared Multiball when available.
Recruit Wheelman, Cat Burglar, Safecracker, Hacker, and Demolition, rescuing anyone who is jailed.
Complete a Mastermind heist and collect its jewel at the raised scoop.
With all six crew available, shoot the center jail to start the Big Final Heist.
Use each collected MacGuffin to simplify its crew phase, then reach the final 15 Car Monte sequence.

playfieldReferences.label: Five crew shots
playfieldReferences.description: The two orbits, two ramps, and right horseshoe tied to the five recruitable specialists.

playfieldReferences.label: OCPD jail
playfieldReferences.description: The center gate and scoop used for Side Jobs, Jailbreak, and the Big Final Heist.

playfieldReferences.label: Police lock targets
playfieldReferences.description: The blue-flashing targets that light Police Multiball locks at the horseshoes.

playfieldReferences.label: Mastermind and Police lock shot
playfieldReferences.description: The left horseshoe used for a Police lock and the Mastermind route after enough crew are recruited.

cautions.issue: Code 1.0.1.3 behavior can differ from current code 2.3.0.0.
cautions.response: The February 2025 exact-machine play confirms the two-hit crew start; read the display for later scoring, timers, and feature additions.
